content.title: The Resurrection of the Son of God (Christian Origins and the Question of God, vol. 3)
content.author: N. T. Wright (Minneapolis: Fortress Press, 2003)
content.note: A historian's case that what 'resurrection' meant to first-century Jews (a new bodily life, not survival of the soul) explains why the early Christians spoke as they did, and that the empty tomb and the appearances together best explain the rise of that belief. In copyright: described in our own words and cited by part, never quoted; no page numbers are given because no copy is held.
